baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَلَقْنَا ... مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ ... نَبْتَلِيهِ ... فَجَعَلْنَاهُ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا
baseline_models.mechanism: A measured mixed liquid is transformed into a responsive subject; trial discloses that subject's condition, while understanding and inner sight make the disclosure possible.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning makes creation a calibrated preparation rather than an undifferentiated event.
Clear water ranging from a drop to semen supplies the fluid substrate of the preparation.
Mixing and blending makes plurality within the substrate functional rather than incidental.
Testing that reveals a condition supplies the disclosure operation applied to the formed subject.
Turning something into a state marks hearing and sight as an installed condition.
Understanding and compliance makes hearing a responsive capacity rather than sound detection alone.
Inner sight supplies discernment within the subject whose state is being disclosed.

changed_reading.before: A biological creation statement followed by a generic test and two sensory endowments.
changed_reading.after: A calibrated disclosure sequence in which a mixed substrate becomes an agent whose condition can appear through receptive and discerning capacities.

baseline_models.mechanism: The human is both a visible presence over against hiddenness and a being who brings things into awareness; the final hearing and sight complete that two-way emergence into perceptibility.

activation_trace.role: Originating and bringing into being supplies the transition into manifest existence.
Visible human presence against hidden or wild beings makes the created human an appearing presence.
Perceiving by seeing, sensing, or hearing turns the same human into an apprehending presence.
Hearing sounds gives one concrete channel for the human's outward receptivity.
Seeing with the eye gives the paired channel by which the visible human also sees.

changed_reading.before: The human is merely the object created and then equipped with senses.
changed_reading.after: Human creation is emergence into mutual perceptibility: a presence that can be encountered and can itself apprehend.

baseline_models.mechanism: Trial can include beautiful benefaction, so the faculties following it can be read as enabling gifts within the trial: the subject is made apt to answer rather than merely exposed to inspection.

activation_trace.role: Worthiness and aptness lets creation include preparation for a demanded response.
A good trial or beautiful benefaction keeps testing and gift within one semantic operation.
Transformation into a state makes the faculties bestowed equipment.
Understanding and compliance supplies answerability as the gift's practical effect.
Inner sight supplies the discrimination needed for an answerable trial.

changed_reading.before: Hearing and sight are neutral faculties appended to a test.
changed_reading.after: Hearing and sight are beneficent provisions inside the test, making a responsible answer possible.

baseline_models.mechanism: Interlaced composition, worn cloth, and bodily decay cross-activate a material model in which testing is stress and attrition that reveals how the composite holds.

activation_trace.role: Worn and threadbare fabric gives creation an unexpected material image of a surface altered by use.
Interlaced threads render the mixed origin as a composite that can hold or fray under stress.
Wearing out and decay supplies attrition as the physical analogue of trial.
Testing that discloses condition connects material wear to revelation of the composite's state.

changed_reading.before: Trial is an external event imposed on an already completed human.
changed_reading.after: Trial can be imagined as a wear test of the human's interlaced composition, exposing what that formed composite becomes under use.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding negation of being, thinghood, and mention turns creation into a threshold from non-reportability into the perceptible, testable presence described in the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence supplies the focus-side endpoint of the threshold.
Bringing into being supplies the transition from the preceding negations.
Disclosure of condition makes emerging into mentionability consequential.
Occurrence and presence in time supplies the explicitly negated prior state.
A thing knowable and reportable sharpens what the human had not yet been.
Mention running on the tongue supplies public reportability as the threshold's far side.

structural_cues: 76:1 immediately precedes the focus and negates prior being as a mentioned thing.
76:2 then moves through creation, trial, and perceptive capacity without changing its human referent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated presence, thinghood, and mention before creation; I infer a directional threshold into testable publicity. A live alternative is that 76:1 is only a rhetorical temporal preface, not a process stage.

changed_reading.before: Human creation is emergence into perceptibility in a biological frame.
changed_reading.after: Human creation is also entry from non-mentionability into a presence whose condition can be perceived, disclosed, and spoken of.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance supplies an indicated route and gratitude or covering supplies the response split, so hearing and inner sight become the uptake architecture through which trial yields divergent conduct.

activation_trace.role: Testing that reveals state supplies the operation whose outputs the next ayah differentiates.
Understanding and compliance makes hearing a candidate channel for receiving guidance.
Inner sight makes discernment of the indicated way part of the response mechanism.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies what the perceptive capacities receive.
An extended traversable road turns guidance into a course that can be taken.
Recognizing a benefit and praising its giver supplies one disclosed response to the route.
Veiling the truth supplies the opposed response as blocked uptake rather than absent equipment.

structural_cues: 76:3 immediately follows the installation of hearing and sight.
The paired إِمَّا ... وَإِمَّا construction presents two outcomes after one guidance event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies faculties, a gently indicated path, and two response poles; I infer that the faculties mediate uptake of that path. They could instead be witnesses to a choice generated by some other capacity.

changed_reading.before: Hearing and sight make the human generally testable.
changed_reading.after: They make the human capable of receiving one indicated way and disclosing either grateful uptake or active covering of it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human begins as mixed liquid but later acts as drinker and recipient of repeatedly mixed and finally purifying drink; trial sits between passive material composition and morally differentiated participation in liquid.

activation_trace.role: A clear drop including reproductive fluid supplies the human's initial passive liquid role.
Mixing and blending marks composition as the focus ayah's material operation.
Transformation into a state enables the shift from liquid material to perceiving participant.
Taking in liquid reverses the human's role from substance to active drinker.
Mixing one thing with another repeats the focus ayah's compositional operation in the first cup.
The second mixed cup makes the compositional recurrence structural rather than isolated.
Giving drink to quench makes the formed human the recipient of liquid from the Lord.
A purifying substance gives the liquid trajectory a cleansing endpoint beyond mere mixture.

structural_cues: The reward block repeats the formula كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا at 76:5 and 76:17.
The same block culminates in the Lord giving them a purifying drink at 76:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mixed origin, two mixed cups, drinking, and purifying drink; I supply the material role-reversal arrow through trial. A live alternative is ordinary recurrence of beverage vocabulary with no anthropological return.

changed_reading.before: The mixed drop only identifies the material from which the human was produced.
changed_reading.after: The mixed drop opens a liquid arc: passive mixture becomes an answerable drinker who may receive prepared mixtures and finally purifying drink.

context_deltas.mechanism: The test becomes an encounter with visible human need: disrupted provision, guardianship, and freedom call for feeding, while refusal to seek return makes the response nonreciprocal and therefore diagnostic.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence keeps the test attached to encounters among humans.
Testing that reveals condition makes conduct toward need evidentiary.
Understanding and response makes hearing a capacity to register another's claim.
Inner sight supplies discernment of need beyond its visible surface.
Feeding another turns perception into material provision.
A child cut off from a guardian supplies need created by broken support.
Binding and captivity supplies need created by constrained freedom.
Will and desire, explicitly negated here, removes self-directed return from the feeding mechanism.
Recompense for an act, also negated as a motive, makes nonreciprocity visible.

structural_cues: 76:8 coordinates the poor person, orphan, and captive as recipients of one feeding act.
76:9 voices the feeders' refusal of recompense or thanks and exposes the act's direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perceptive faculties, vulnerable relations, feeding, and negated return; I infer that noticing and answering such claims is a concrete field of the trial. The exemplars may illustrate only one outcome rather than define the trial's full scope.

changed_reading.before: The test discloses an individual's response to guidance in general.
changed_reading.after: The test also asks what a perceptive human does when another human's need is visible and no reciprocal gain is sought.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus ayah's interlacing and wear branches gain a downstream textile field: holding oneself under stress is answered immediately with silk, and clothing later returns with a branch that can also stand for the self.

activation_trace.role: Threadbare cloth supplies the focus-side image of material altered through use.
Interlaced threads render the mixed human as a woven composite.
Wear and decay supplies the stress process activated by the later textile imagery.
Holding the self back from panic supplies the human mode of enduring stress.
Fine silk supplies the immediate textile return for endurance.
Garment and covering, including its use for the self, keeps cloth and person in one downstream image.

structural_cues: 76:12 directly joins because they endured to garden and silk.
76:21 returns to clothing near the reward sequence's culmination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interlaced threads, wear, endurance, silk, and clothing; I infer a stress-and-textile return around the human composite. The safer alternative is that silk and garments are independent reward imagery.

changed_reading.before: The wear-test model is an isolated branch interaction inside the focus ayah.
changed_reading.after: The surah carries that model into endurance and textiles, letting the worn interlaced self be answered in the semantic material of fine clothing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Delivered recitation is followed by a prohibition on obedience, splitting the focus branch's paired understanding-and-compliance: hearing must receive speech without granting every speaker control.

activation_trace.role: Testing that reveals state makes selection among heard claims diagnostic.
Understanding and compliance supplies the bundled relation that context separates.
Causing something to descend and reach its recipient supplies delivered speech for audition.
Reading and recitation supplies the heard content that can guide action.
Submission and obedience, here prohibited toward some speakers, makes compliance selective.

structural_cues: 76:23 announces emphatic delivery of the recitation.
76:24 immediately follows with do not obey, distinguishing reception from submission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hearing branch that joins understanding to compliance, then delivered recitation and selective non-obedience; I infer an ethical gate between hearing and obeying. The direct addressee in 76:23-24 may limit how far this models the generic human of 76:2.

changed_reading.before: Hearing's understanding-and-compliance branch reads as a single receptive capacity.
changed_reading.after: Hearing is tested precisely by separating understanding from automatic compliance and choosing which heard speech governs action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The perceiving test subject acts by taking a path and willing, yet that agency operates in a divinely bound body that can be replaced and under a will on which human willing depends.

activation_trace.role: Originating the human supplies agency's created rather than self-originating basis.
Testing and disclosure preserves meaningful response inside the later constraints.
Installing a state makes hearing and sight granted capacities rather than autonomous possessions.
Will directed toward a thing supplies both human willing and the divine willing on which it is made dependent.
Firm bodily formation and joined structure supplies the created frame within which choice occurs.
One thing standing in another's place makes embodied agents replaceable rather than sovereign.
Taking and acquiring supplies the human-side act of adopting a route.

structural_cues: 76:28 repeats We created them, then names bodily binding and possible replacement.
76:29 invites taking a path, while 76:30 places human willing under divine willing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created bodily cohesion, replacement, path-taking, and nested wills; I infer that these define the scope of the focus ayah's tested agency. They may instead qualify later response without redefining the installed faculties themselves.

changed_reading.before: Perceptive equipment appears to confer an autonomous chooser who undergoes a test.
changed_reading.after: The chooser is real but bounded: perception and path-taking operate within granted, replaceable embodiment and dependent willing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing entry into mercy activates the womb branch of the same root, allowing the focus ayah's reproductive origin to become the first enclosure in an arc whose possible endpoint is admission into a second, protective interior.

activation_trace.role: Originating and bringing into being supplies the first emergence.
Reproductive fluid supplies the focus ayah's gestational material anchor.
Mixed reproductive and bodily substance keeps the first enclosure specifically generative.
Trial as disclosure fills the interval between emergence and possible re-entry.
Entering an interior supplies the directional movement at the surah's close.
Mercy and tenderness supplies the explicit protective quality of the destination.
The female womb supplies the surprising enclosure image that reconnects the ending to reproductive origin.

structural_cues: 76:2 describes creation from reproductive mixture, while 76:31 closes the whole-surah window with entry into mercy.
The spatial contrast from a drop and into mercy supports an emergence-to-entry arc.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reproductive material, inward entry, and mercy/womb branches; I supply the second-gestation analogy across the surah. The live alternative is that mercy invokes tenderness only and has no gestational force here.

changed_reading.before: The mixed drop is a one-time biological origin followed by life under trial.
changed_reading.after: It can be the first term of a two-enclosure arc: emergence from generative mixture, testing, then possible admission into a mercy imagined cautiously through the womb branch.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses social captivity and bodily construction through one root, but it remains anchored in the focus ayah's created interlaced human and trial, and both context senses are branch-backed. Downstream prose should present it as a root-mediated analogy that unsettles distance from the captive, not as a claim that أَسْرَهُمْ literally means prisoners or that every body is juridically captive.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَانَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَبْتَلِيهِ

activation_trace.role: Measured formation supplies the constructed body to which binding can attach.
Interlaced threads supply a material image of parts held together.
Disclosure through testing makes the shared condition ethically consequential.
Binding and captivity supplies the socially constrained person whom the righteous feed.
Firm bodily formation and joined joints returns the same root inside every created body.
Tightening a bond or fastening makes bodily cohesion an explicit act of binding.

changed_reading.before: The created test subject and the captive encountered later are categorically separate positions.
changed_reading.after: The captive's binding echoes the binding that constitutes every created body, so social care can disclose recognition of a shared bound embodiment.

strongest_changes: 76:3 turns hearing and inner sight into the reception architecture of a guided, bifurcated response.
Repeated mixture and drinking language moves the human from passive mixed fluid to an agent who drinks and is given morally differentiated liquids.
76:8-9 locates testing in nonreciprocal attention to vulnerable humans, while 76:23-24 makes hearing selective rather than automatic compliance.
76:28-30 bounds path-taking agency inside created embodiment, replaceability, and dependent willing.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed material and relational returns that a short window would hide: mixture returns as beverage, textile wear returns as silk and clothing, bodily binding shares a root with the captive, and closing mercy carries a live womb branch.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax leaves open whether hearing and sight are instruments, outcomes, or benefactions of the trial.
The textile, captivity/binding, and womb/mercy readings are branch-driven analogies rather than claims of lexical equivalence in context.
The direct address in 76:23-24 may model general human audition without directly redefining every human's test.
